document.title: Synthetic backup and restore test record
document.text:
SYNTHETIC QA EVIDENCE — BACKUP AND RESTORE CONTROL STATUS

Scope: all production systems and important business data.
Review date: 2026-07-26.

Backups are created on a regular schedule. However, no restoration
test has ever been performed for any production system. There are no
documented restore-test results, no evidence that backed-up systems
can be recovered, and no assigned owner or schedule for restoration
testing.

The questionnaire assertion that backup restoration is regularly
tested is incorrect and must not be relied upon. Restore capability
remains unverified until an end-to-end recovery test is completed and
documented.

items.title: Backups and emergency preparedness
items.sourceRecommendation: Document, implement, and regularly test backup restoration processes to ensure recoverability of critical data and systems. Assign clear responsibilities and a test schedule. Maintain thorough records of restoration test procedures and outcomes. For compliance, maintain documentation and support independent verification beyond internal self-reporting.
items.objective: Ensure that backup restoration is regularly tested so that critical data and systems can be reliably recovered in case of incident or emergency.

deliverables.text: Documented plan and schedule for backup restore testing
Assignment of responsibility for restore tests
Evidence (e.g., test reports, logs) of completed restore tests covering production systems

acceptanceCriteria.text: At least one documented and completed restore test for each covered production system
Traceable assignment of responsibility for ongoing restore testing
A scheduled and recurring process for regular restore tests

suggestedEvidence.text: Backup restoration test plans and procedures
Evidence of responsible owner assignment and promulgated schedule

actual.recommendation: The questionnaire responses report this requirement as implemented. The following recommendation supports maintenance and evidence readiness for independent verification; it does not find that the control is missing: Maintain up-to-date documentation assigning information-security responsibility; ensure records of management approval, oversight, and regular training are available and evidencable. Periodically review these documents to ensure compliance and provide independent verification if needed.

automaticChecks.name: NIS2-RISK-02 fulfilled maintenance framing
automaticChecks.expected: explicit questionnaire self-report framing, independent-verification context, and no action objective

actual.recommendation: The questionnaire responses report this requirement as implemented. The following recommendation supports maintenance and evidence readiness for independent verification; it does not find that the control is missing: Document and maintain up-to-date risk analysis and asset inventories, and ensure periodic reviews. Retain records that can independently evidence these controls for external verification.

automaticChecks.name: NIS2-IAM-03 fulfilled maintenance framing
automaticChecks.expected: explicit questionnaire self-report framing, independent-verification context, and no action objective

actual.recommendation: The questionnaire responses report this requirement as implemented. The following recommendation supports maintenance and evidence readiness for independent verification; it does not find that the control is missing: Maintain documentation of access control policies, least-privilege principles, and procedures for joiner/mover/leaver processes and multi-factor authentication. Regularly review and retain objective evidence for independent verification.

automaticChecks.name: NIS2-IR-04 fulfilled maintenance framing
automaticChecks.expected: explicit questionnaire self-report framing, independent-verification context, and no action objective

actual.recommendation: The questionnaire responses report this requirement as implemented. The following recommendation supports maintenance and evidence readiness for independent verification; it does not find that the control is missing: Ensure up-to-date, documented incident response plans, roles, and reporting procedures, including evidence of detection and reporting within required timeframes. Regularly review and maintain these records for verification.

automaticChecks.name: NIS2-BC-05 fulfilled maintenance framing
automaticChecks.expected: explicit questionnaire self-report framing, independent-verification context, and no action objective

actual.recommendation: The questionnaire responses report this requirement as implemented. The following recommendation supports maintenance and evidence readiness for independent verification; it does not find that the control is missing: Assign a responsible owner for backup restoration testing, conduct an end-to-end recovery test, and document results. Update evidence to confirm restore capability for all critical systems and data, and correct any inconsistent self-reporting.

automaticChecks.name: NIS2-SC-06 fulfilled maintenance framing
automaticChecks.expected: explicit questionnaire self-report framing, independent-verification context, and no action objective

actual.recommendation: The questionnaire responses report this requirement as implemented. The following recommendation supports maintenance and evidence readiness for independent verification; it does not find that the control is missing: Maintain and periodically review evidence of supplier risk assessment, contract provisions for security, and contingency processes relating to external providers. Documented and reviewed records help enable independent verification.

automaticChecks.name: NIS2-VM-07 fulfilled maintenance framing
automaticChecks.expected: explicit questionnaire self-report framing, independent-verification context, and no action objective

actual.recommendation: The questionnaire responses report this requirement as implemented. automaticChecks.name: NIS2-ASSURE-08 fulfilled maintenance framing

automaticChecks.name: NIS2-AWARE-09 fulfilled maintenance framing
automaticChecks.expected: explicit questionnaire self-report framing, independent-verification context, and no action objective

actual.recommendation: The questionnaire responses report this requirement as implemented.
